_doc: Shadow STT discrepancy classification policy. Spec: research.md §4. Compared per spec.md FR-030 across 7 logical high-value categories stored as 9 atomic enum values (data-model.md §1.7 storage normalization). Benign matches are silent; uncertain matches escalate the session to `needs_human_review` with reason `shadow_stt_discrepancy` per FR-031 (provided the discrepancy event arrives inside the grace window per FR-029 Round 2 Q7).

benign_rules._doc: Differences that the policy treats as benign — silent, no escalation.

case_insensitive_match.rule: Treat live vs. shadow values as equivalent if they match after lowercasing.

whitespace_normalization.rule: Treat values as equivalent if they match after collapsing whitespace and trimming.

phonetic_spelling_tolerance.rule: Treat names with the same Metaphone/Soundex encoding as equivalent (handles 'Smith' vs 'Smyth').

punctuation_in_email.rule: Treat emails as equivalent if they match after stripping surrounding punctuation.

uncertain_rules._doc: Differences that the policy treats as uncertain — escalate to `needs_human_review` with reason `shadow_stt_discrepancy` (when the discrepancy event arrives inside the grace window per FR-029).

semantically_different_email.rule: After benign normalization, two non-empty emails that still differ are uncertain.

callback_window_more_than_one_day.rule: Two parsed callback windows whose start times differ by more than 24 hours are uncertain.

opt_out_vs_interest_disagreement.rule: If one path emits opt_out=true and the other emits interest_level > none, the discrepancy is uncertain.

disposition_disagreement.rule: Any final_disposition disagreement (after normalization) is uncertain.

wrong_number_disagreement.rule: Any wrong_number boolean disagreement is uncertain.

callback_intent_disagreement.rule: Any callback_intent disagreement is uncertain unless one side is null AND the call was clearly non-connected.
